name: Salted Caramel Apple Draft Latte
caffeineNote: 135 mg per La Colombe's product page (shown as a marketing badge; caffeine is not listed on the nutrition panel). Not yet label-verified.
summary: Fall seasonal Draft Latte: espresso roast cold brew with lactose-free milk, apple, buttery caramel and sea salt, in the same 9 oz can as the Everyday. La Colombe listed it out of stock when we recorded it on 2026-09-14, and by 2026-10-09 its product page was gone, so it is no longer sold on La Colombe's site. The figures here come from that page, which is why they stay unverified.
